source.author: verg
source.text: At nos hinc alii sitientis ibimus Afros, pars Scythiam et rapidum Cretae veniemus Oaxen, et penitus toto divisos orbe Britannos.
source.text_original: At nos hinc alii sitientis ibimus Afros, / pars Scythiam et rapidum Cretae veniemus Oaxen, / et penitus toto divisos orbe Britannos.
source.text_english: But we shall go from here, some of us to thirsting Africa, others to Scythia, and to the swift Oaxes of Crete, and to the Britons, cut off deep by the whole world.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: diuisus ab orbe nostro Britannus, si in religione processerit, occiduo sole dimisso quaerit locum fama sibi tantum et scripturarum relatione cognitum.
reuse.text_original: diuisus ab orbe nostro Britannus, si in religione processerit, occiduo sole dimisso quaerit locum fama sibi tantum et scripturarum relatione cognitum.
reuse.text_english: Britain, divided off from our world, if it has advanced in religion, seeks a place, with the setting sun left behind, known to it only by report and by the account of the Scriptures.
